title: The Final Ledger
author: Rafael Yarrow
blurb: August Ravensworth, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
